notes.title: Scorching Desert: Epic New Open-World Survival Game Coming June 2025
notes.content:
The Wait is finally over!!!

The Scorching Desert awaits you, Explorer!
It's your time to traverse the desert, fight it's anicient evils and save the world!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/ee877805362cde17ef028acea06703e30e165f51.jpg

We're proud to announce that after nearly 3 years of Development Scorching Desert is finally coming to life and want to thank you for your support and feedback!

We took a lot of your feedback from our demo release in October to heart and think that it already helped improve the gameplay quality by a lot! With your help, we are hoping to forge the game into it's best version and make scorching desert an awesome experience for you!
That being said, feel free to enjoy your journey through the desert!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/3eb6ec61424d4b2020b5ce8d0ea6dd53e645b141.png

On June 19th 2025 you will find yourself waking up in an egyptian desert, with no memory of how you ended up in the dunes. You will scavenge for resources, craft weapons and tools to survive, tame high quality camels and build your own little desert outpost, all while uncovering the mysterious darkness that plagues the Scorching Desert & threatens the entire World! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/4dff7ff001e1693370eb3287f8edad9a34528303.jpg

Only one thing will be certain: You Will Die! or atleast question your existance on your desert journey!

Thank you sooo much for your support!
Desert Runner Studio

notes.title: Steam Game-Preview
notes.content:
Welcome back,

It's been a couple of months now since the last post and we want to thank you for your patience while we've brought the game closer to it's release.
During the last couple of months we've been working really hard on bug fixes, smoother animations, boss fights the building system, unique weather events, progression & enemy behaviour.
Since we've brought the game a lot closer to a final release, we got two big announcements to share with you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/3eb6ec61424d4b2020b5ce8d0ea6dd53e645b141.png

Grab yourself some Water and start exploring the SCORCHING DESERT!

For the start we're really excited to anounce to you that Scorching Desert will be coming up on the next Steam Game-Preview starting October 14th.
You will be able to try out the Scorching Desert Demo to take a preview of the game and help us out on the future path through your feedback!
Start your walk through the ancient desert, make some friends along the way, survive the elements and
face the darkness awaiting you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/e7e17b1064acdb2cbc219230e5a38df2492c6013.jpg

Time to get the Camel

Additionally to our featuring on Game-Preview we're closing in on our official release Date for Scorching Desert, which is hovering around early 2025 but we'll update you on the release Date, whenever we've decided on an exact date! so go ahead, grab  your friendly camel and prepare yourself for the hardest walk in the desert you'll ever have witnessed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/fb45ac245119102f84c4f5a7072484565e123f88.jpg

notes.title: We just finished the Story Dungeons
notes.content:
Hello & Welcome to our 6th progress update!

As you may have seen, our last progress update is now ~ 1 month old and you might be wondering
what we'd been working on over the last month.

Here are some nice scenes from the dungeons!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/fd2459faaf72b1edfc73ea4d456a6900dd17fbdb.png

 We're excited to anounce that we've officially finished most work on the story dungeons in Scorching Desert, and additionally reworked most of the animations - which now look much more beatiful and smoother. We also overhauled our Sounddesign of the game and fixed a lot of bugs concerning the gameplay. Finally we also added some crsip cinematics to our dungeons to increase the immersion in our game and round up the gameplay experience!

Some underwater Scenery!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/b2f3f6d498fb0d0f4d90426b17e17bcbc378c801.png

Could you hold the balance?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/9f5d985bd0935257e8f15241b78510fc637f1cf7.png

Could you survive those dungeons ?

As always a massive thanks for your Support!
We hope you have a great week!

notes.title: Final story Dungeon & Climbing animations
notes.content:
Hello & welcome to our 5th progress update,
today we want to anounce a big milestone in our journey of developing "Scorching Desert".
We have finished the development of the 3 main dungeons (except for 1 boss fight) and in addition we also managed to come up with some cool ladder climbing animations:)
You will now be able to complete the story dungeons solve riddles, receive loot &fight epic boss fights that will shake your bones!
Whenever the last bossfight is finished we will continue working on the endboss of the game, which we can already promise, is going to be a very challenging and complex fight!

Here's some preview from our 3rd story dungeon!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/28ca16f9d8e52ef5c5522c7bebf689f7fbe6603c.png

And here's a link to watch our new climbing animations:
https://x.com/ScorchingDesert/status/1733956724019679622?s=20




And as always we wish you guys an enjoyable week!

Best regards,
Desert Runner Studio

notes.title: The Second Story Dungeon
notes.content:
Hello & welcome to our 4th Progress Update,
we're excited to announce that we've finished the first of our 3 story dungeons and are now starting work on the second story dungeon.
The Story dungeons are composed of a variety of different fights and riddles, all while telling an exciting story about the darkness hidden deep within the desert...
It's your task to complete the journey and uncover the ancient secrets - for which you will be rewarded with great loot!

Here's quick preview of some parts of the dungeon:)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/bf002e2813a6f9bc048e5471eb8d291031931b95.png

And another preview from the second story dungeon:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/9f5d985bd0935257e8f15241b78510fc637f1cf7.png

As always we wish you a very nice start into the week:)

Cheers

notes.title: Progress Update #003
notes.content:
Excited to show you the Main Dungeons!
Hello & welcome to our third progress update. We're very excited to show you some of our newest additions: the story dungeons. In "Scorching Desert" you will be able to find a lot of different dungeons & caves and temple ruins, some of which are more special than others.
These are called the main story dungeons, which are larger more complex & contain an additional mini-boss fight. As a reward for completing one of them you might be getting special loot to help you on your journey through the desert!

Quick Look at one of the main dungeons

notes.title: Designing of Dungeons | Progress Update #002
notes.content:
Welcome to our second Progress Update!

Finished the Steam Achievements!
We're really excited to tell you, we've finished our work on the Steam Achievements, so you'll now be able to collect 62 Achievements (both easy & harder ones) in "Scorching Desert". These Achievements will help you prove that YOU are the ultimate survivor & the ruler of the deser!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/5b4b0ab490cc1b033ce8082d92137ce7de8f6347.png

Exploring some of the Dungeons!
In Scorching Desert you will be able to find many dungeons scattered throughout the map,
some in caves, some in long-forgotten temple ruins and some ... harder to find.
In these dungeons you will need to solve riddles, fight dangerous creatures and prove your worthiness!
Will you be able to complete all of them?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/356420b87e96fa015bc98ce13ec2c06f9fb2f6c7.png

Mini Bosses
We started improving / redesigning some of these ancient dungeons, so they're harder & deadlier!
Additionally we are giving the "special" dungeons mini bosses to fight against.
And for your perserverance you will be rewarded with powerful loot & new crafting recipes to advance your journey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/2ca054cdd34fb9d6c07e9480e6cbab9a70b4703c.png
Do you have what it takes to survive the Scorching Desert?

notes.title: Progress Update #001
notes.content:
Hello Guys and welcome to our first Anouncement

First of all we want to thank you alot for your support!
From now on we'll be posting some of our current development progress on steam& other social media.
So keep an eye out for new features & gameplay in the future!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/413b331beb99ae5496755c1fda8856e1d3de634f.png

We currently finished our work on the Camel - your best Friend in the lone desert
You'll be able to tame a camel with special food found in some of the oasis in the dunes biome.
Whenever you've met your friend and tamed him up he'll be able to equip a saddle and let you ride him through the desert at way faster pace!
Additionally he can carry some of your baggage for you and provide some shade via mountable sun protection - no more painful sunburns during your journeys!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686525/ffaaf7ad239144f9ee6b111ae513099f8aeecaa9.png

Starting to work on the Steam Achievements
We're now focusing on Steam Achievements & some minor bug fixes / optimizations in UE5
The Icons & Ideas for Achievements are already finished! We'll be excited to implement the trigger events and Steam functionality into our game.
Additionally you'll be able to submit some ideas for Achievements in the future, whenver we've finished building our discord server!

Wish you all a great week,
Desert Runner Studio
